device-callback.p7 is a synthetic, encapsulated CMS SignedData callback containing a plist with UDID, PRODUCT, and VERSION, signed with a self-signed RSA test certificate using OpenSSL cms -sign -binary -nodetach -outform DER. It models the signed profile-service response described by Apple. It is not a captured device response and proves neither Apple certificate trust nor live iOS acceptance. The private key was discarded.
